newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso ends mixed after stock market inflows.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso ends mixed after stock market inflows.

text.p: The Mexican peso ended mixed against the dollar due to foreign capital inflows on the Mexican stock exchange, purchasing of peso contracts in Chicago and profit-taking, dealers said.
"The market was very volatile, there was no clear direction and everyone was waiting," one trader said.
Same day contracts ended with a marginal rise of 0.10 centavos at 7.9385/7.9410.
The 24-hour contract rose 0.40 centavos to 7.9425/7.9450, while the 48-hour contract eased 0.40 pesos to 7.9525/7.9550. ((--Alexis Quinones, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7905))
